articles.title: One fruit can clean your gut, lower blood sugar. But biting its seeds can lead to poisoning
articles.description: Apple seeds contain a poisonous substance called cyanide when crushed. Medical specialist Dr. Suraj Baidya highlighted this important safety fact on X. Apples themselves offer significant nutritional benefits and disease protection.
